title: Foods with more potassium than a banana

seo.title: Foods with more potassium than a banana
seo.meta_description: Banana has about 358 mg potassium per 100 g, but potatoes, cooked spinach, beans, avocado, and other foods can provide more by weight or serving.
seo.search_intent: Find foods with more potassium than banana and compare amounts per 100 g and realistic serving.

excerpt: Bananas are a useful potassium source, but they are not among the most concentrated foods. A banana provides about 358 mg per 100 g. Baked potatoes, cooked spinach, beans, avocado, and some fish can exceed that amount, and one medium baked potato can provide roughly 700–900+ mg depending on size and preparation.
content_html:
Bananas have become almost synonymous with potassium, but their reputation is stronger than their ranking. At about 358 mg per 100 g, they are useful, not exceptional.

Potassium per 100 grams and per serving

FoodPotassium/100 gTypical servingPotassium/serving
Baked potato with skin~535 mg180 g~960 mg
Cooked spinach~466 mg150 g~700 mg
Cooked white beans~560 mg180 g~1,000 mg
Avocado~485 mg100 g~485 mg
Cooked salmon~380–490 mg142 g~540–700 mg
Banana~358 mg120 g~430 mg

A medium potato or a cup of beans can provide roughly twice as much potassium as a medium banana.

Why potatoes and beans stand out

A potato is eaten in a relatively large portion, while beans combine substantial potassium with fiber and protein. Cooking method and draining can move the exact values.

Avocado beats banana gram for gram

At roughly 485 versus 358 mg per 100 g, avocado contains about 35% more potassium by weight. It is also more calorie-dense, at about 160 calories per 100 g versus about 89 for banana.

Variety works better than one champion

Potassium is spread across fruits, vegetables, legumes, potatoes, dairy, and fish. A varied diet can provide plenty without relying on a single food.

The useful takeaway

Bananas are convenient, but potatoes, beans, spinach, and avocado can provide more potassium. For people who have been told to restrict potassium, individualized dietary guidance takes priority over general rankings.

faq.question: What has more potassium than a banana?
faq.answer: A medium potato, a cup of white beans, or a serving of cooked spinach can provide substantially more potassium than a medium banana.

faq.question: How much potassium is in a banana?
faq.answer: About 358 mg per 100 g; a medium banana around 120 g provides roughly 430 mg.

faq.question: Does avocado have more potassium than banana?
faq.answer: Yes per 100 g: about 485 mg versus 358 mg, although avocado is also more calorie-dense.
